links.comparator_used: Genomic-only and image-only single-modality baselines (plus late fusion)
links.outcome: ecDNA detection AUROC on synthetic images
links.effect: AUROC 0.87 for early-fusion multi-modal vs 0.72 genomic-only, 0.79 image-only, 0.84 late fusion (all p<0.001)
links.tradeoff: Results are on synthetic FISH images only; validation with real clinical FISH data is needed before deployment.
links.quote: On synthetic images, our framework achieved AUROC 0.87, significantly outperforming genomic-only (0.72), image-only (0.79), and late fusion (0.84) baselines (all p<0.001).

links.effect: Confidence improved by 0.9 points (Cohen's d=1.26, p<0.001) with explanations
links.quote: Expert diagnostic confidence improved by 0.9 points (Cohen’s d=1.26, p<0.001) with explanations.
